entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Mosque of Abu Ubaidah Amer ibn al-Jarrah is a mosque and mausoleum complex located in the town of Deir Alla, in the governorate of Balqa, Jordan. It contains the purported tomb of Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah, one of the Sahabah and a military commander of the Rashidun Caliphate.
